open_question: Issue #30 reports 90-105 s. The exact scan here is far below that on this machine, and nothing measured here explains the difference. The experiment that would settle it costs one minute on the reporter’s machine: run the same query twice in a row. Much faster the second time means the cost is getting the bytes off disk; the same both times means it is arithmetic. Until then the gap is unattributed.
